summary.result: The performance of low carbon green concrete used fly ash, limestone powder and blast furnace slag powder were remarkably improved.
summary.background: Accordingly, the fly ash, limestone powder and blast furnace slag powder can be used for offshore structure materials.
summary.method: This fact is expected to have economical effects in the manufacture of low carbon green concrete for offshore structures.
